1. (Currently amended) A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles __having a size of 8-12 μm__; a thermally conductive binder __comprising premixed solder paste__; and a solvent.

2. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface __to form boiling nucleation sites thereon__.

3. (Currently amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface __and the thermally conductive binder is melted to affix the cavity-generating particles to the electronic component surface__.
